outcome: Success rate of uterine balloon tamponade in controlling postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 49 women who underwent balloon tamponade treatment for primary postpartum hemorrhage at two French hospitals
finding: Uterine balloon tamponade was successful in controlling postpartum hemorrhage in 65% of cases.
mod_finding: Uterine balloon tamponade was used in 30 (61%) after vaginal delivery and 19 (39%) after cesarean section.
